result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is truncated to 'Tokumaru Ramer' in the Popular right now section.

issues.description: Restaurant name under 'Popular right now' reads 'Tokumaru Ramer' with the final character(s) cut off, likely should be 'Tokumaru Ramen'. The title shares a row with the rating '4.8 (500+)' and does not have enough width.
issues.suggestion: Give the title more flexible width, allow wrapping to two lines or proper ellipsis, and ensure the full restaurant name is visible alongside the rating
